description:
FOUND + FIXED s517b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-15) while bringing up the zlib shim (#3161).

REPRO (perl 5.40.3): use Symbol; my $g = Symbol::gensym(); *$g->{A} = 1; print *$g->{A}  # perl 1; PCL died "Not a HASH reference" (emission: (p-dynamic-typeglob (p-gethash-deref $g "A"))).  Same for *{$g}->{A}.

CAUSE: Pl/PExpr.pm's subscript arm folds a leading cast run into the base only when every cast is `$` (#211/#305, _all_scalar_casts).  With a real arrow a glob cast is a deref level too.

FIX: _all_arrow_deref_casts (accepts `$` and `*`), used by the arrow branch of the subscript arm only; the METHOD arms keep _all_scalar_casts (`*$o->m` dies in perl, nothing to fold).  Guard Pl/t/zlib-01.t section 2 (fails on main dc87c403).

=== DONE (s517b) ===
subject: `*$g->{k}` parsed as `*{ $g->{k} }` (a glob of a hash element) instead of `(*$g)->{k}`, the glob's hash -- IO::Compress::Base::Common's createSelfTiedObject died "Not a HASH reference"
